title: Troubleshooting
summary: A short diagnostic path for local setup, builds, deployment, domains, and runtime failures.

sections.heading: Local setup fails
body: Confirm the repository is on the expected branch, the supported Node.js runtime is installed, Corepack is enabled, and dependencies are installed from the lockfile.
Run the smallest failing command first so the error remains attributable to one stage.

sections.heading: Build or type-check fails
body: Run pnpm lint, pnpm type-check, and pnpm build independently. Check the first meaningful compiler or build error rather than the final cascade of messages.

examples.code:
pnpm lint
pnpm type-check
pnpm build

sections.heading: Deployment fails
body: Check the selected provider, project target, credentials, workflow run, artifact identity, and provider logs. A failed deployment must remain visible as failed until a new verified delivery succeeds.

sections.heading: Domain or HTTPS fails
body: Verify DNS resolution, authoritative records, routing target, certificate issuance, hostname coverage, and redirect behavior independently. DNS success alone does not prove application reachability.

sections.heading: Security first
body: Never paste API tokens, OAuth secrets, database URLs, or private deployment credentials into issues or public documentation. Redact logs before sharing them for diagnosis.
